Real rewards. Real participation.

Giveaways on Turne are a participation mechanic, not a lottery ticket. You show up, you join in, and you get a real shot at something worth having.

What you can win

  • Physical productsThings brands make, shipped to you.
  • Event ticketsEntry to gigs, fests and sessions.
  • Discount couponsMoney off with the brands you follow.
  • Digital productsSubscriptions, downloads and in-app items.
  • MembershipsAccess to clubs and programmes.
  • ExperiencesMeet-ups, workshops and access you can't buy.
  • Brand rewardsPerks a brand designs for its community.
  • Enter at launchWaitlist members are first through the door.Join the waitlist

Everyone gets a shot.

For eligible giveaways, opportunities are split evenly. Premium members get access to a dedicated 50% share. It improves your access. It never guarantees a win.

Allocation applies to selected eligible giveaways. Winners are drawn within each share.

How a giveaway works

The short version of our giveaway terms.

  • Free to enter

    No purchase, stake or wager. Turne is not a gambling or betting platform.

    Terms C1

  • Clear rules

    Each giveaway states its entry window, eligibility, number of prizes and draw date.

    Terms C3

  • Random draw

    Winners are picked at random from valid entries within each share.

    Terms C5

  • WhatsApp notice

    Winners hear from us on their registered WhatsApp number.

    Terms C5

  • Fair play

    Multiple accounts, false details or automation get entries disqualified.
